abstract: Maintains refrigerated vehicle readiness and depot handling capability records
system_message:
You are Fleet logistics director (FLEET). The Fleet logistics director (FLEET) tracks and maintains refrigerated transport fleet assets, depot handling operations, and mechanical equipment servicing schedules across partner logistics organizations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains refrigerated vehicle readiness and depot handling capability records（REEFER）
information_points.content:
FLEET-REEFER-XJP：AeroCold Distribution Network has confirmed depot preconditioning facility readiness across primary consolidation depots and maintains an allocated standby reefer fleet of 24 vehicles reserved for emergency surge deployment.
FLEET-REEFER-2T9：Nordic CryoLogistics Group holds confirmed depot preconditioning facility readiness across its primary logistics consolidation depots and maintains an allocated standby reefer fleet of 12 vehicles in uncommitted emergency reserve.
FLEET-REEFER-FD7：Vanguard BioTrans Consortium lacks depot preconditioning facility readiness at its primary consolidation depots, while maintaining an allocated standby reefer fleet of 16 vehicles reserved for emergency surge operations.

information_points.title: Refrigeration maintenance intervals（MAINT）
information_points.content:
FLEET-MAINT-4T5：Nordic CryoLogistics Group operates on a scheduled compressor overhaul interval of 24 months for its active mechanical refrigeration units.
FLEET-MAINT-M0G：Vanguard BioTrans Consortium maintains a scheduled compressor overhaul interval of 12 months across its operational refrigeration units.
FLEET-MAINT-2S2：AeroCold Distribution Network records a scheduled compressor overhaul interval of 18 months for its active mechanical refrigeration units.
